name: Migros Ticaret A.S.
summary: Migros Ticaret A.S., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail sale of food and beverages, and consumer goods in Turkey. It is also involved in online food retailing; takeout food business; provision of payment and e-money, motorcycle courier, electric vehicle charging, and corporate payment services, as well as shopping mall management. In addition, the company engages in media, logistics, and fintech businesses; and production of packaged food production. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
